title: Adam and Eve as a memory of genetic manipulation

tellings.quote: >> when uh they talk about the first human beings I assume that that is a recounting of a genetic manipulation.

plain: The Bible's account of the first human beings, Adam and Eve, may be a retelling of a genetic manipulation of early humans. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan offers this as his own reading of the story, talking with Michels about aliens.
